removes.rationale: AAPL is showing real-time relative weakness (down ~9% YTD vs. a rising market by early March 2024) and produced no distinguishing Gen-AI catalyst this quarter, unlike MSFT and GOOGL which each shipped concrete AI product moves and NVDA which posted a blowout AI-driven quarter; the AI wave is already well covered by MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA, so the slot is better spent on the fresher LUNR catalyst.

news_evidence.summary: AAPL shares down 8.9% YTD as of early March 2024, underperforming the S&P 100 (+8.5%) and Nasdaq Composite (+7.9%); technical pattern shows a lower high in February followed by distribution

rationale_overall: Net effect: rotate a redundant, relatively weak mega-cap AI-adjacent slot (AAPL, no distinct Q1 catalyst) into a catalyst-confirmed, thesis-specific rockets & spacecraft name (LUNR, first US lunar soft landing since Apollo), keeping the watchlist at 12/12 and wave-bucket diversity intact (rockets_spacecraft now RKLB/ASTS/LUNR = 3; AI now MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA = 3). Everything else is a hold on dated Q1-2024 evidence: NVDA's record Q4 FY24 print supports the AI wave; RKLB's $515M USSF prime-contractor win and ASTS's 5-0 FCC approval of Supplemental Coverage from Space draft rules sustain rockets/spacecraft; IONQ's new South Carolina Quantum partnership keeps the quantum buildup alive; ongoing Red Sea/Houthi disruption keeps FRO's tanker thesis intact; NATO's Feb-2024 European defense-spending report supports ITA; BOTZ holds on Nvidia's Project GR00T humanoid-robotics model; WELL (demographics) has no adverse news.
